-다.name: Plain declarative before a quotative ending

transforms.name: -거든(요)
transforms.description: Ending -거든(요): giving a reason; or connective "if".

transforms.name: -게
transforms.description: Ending -게: adverb (so that, -ly); before 되다 and 하다.

transforms.name: -겠-
transforms.description: Pre-final ending -겠-: future, intention, conjecture or politeness.

transforms.name: -(으)ㄹ걸(요)
transforms.description: Guess or regret: probably; I should have.

transforms.name: -(으)ㄴ
transforms.description: Adnominal -(으)ㄴ: past of a verb, present of an adjective.

transforms.name: -는걸(요)
transforms.description: Mild assertion or surprise about a fact.

transforms.name: -는구나
transforms.description: Exclamation of a verb in the present (해라체).

transforms.name: -는군(요)
transforms.description: Exclamation of a verb in the present.

transforms.name: -ㄴ/는다
transforms.description: Plain present statement of a verb (해라체).

transforms.name: -는데/-(으)ㄴ데(요)
transforms.description: Background or contrast: and, but; softened statement (-는데 after verbs, 있다 and 없다; -(으)ㄴ데 after adjectives and 이다).

transforms.name: -는지/-(으)ㄴ지
transforms.description: Connective -는지, -(으)ㄴ지: whether, what; -(으)ㄴ지 after a verb: since (time).

transforms.name: -(으)라
transforms.description: Written-style command (해라체), as in instructions and headlines.

transforms.name: -(이)라서
transforms.description: Connective of 이다 and 아니다: because it is.

transforms.name: -(으)러
transforms.description: Connective -(으)러: in order to (with a verb of motion).

transforms.name: -(으)세요
transforms.description: Honorific polite ending (-(으)시- + -어요): statement, question or polite request.

transforms.name: -아/어
transforms.description: Informal plain ending (해체): statement, question, command or suggestion.

transforms.name: -아/어다가
transforms.description: Connective -아/어다가: do and then (take it somewhere): 가져다가.

transforms.name: -아/어야
transforms.description: Connective -아/어야: only if; before 하다 and 되다: must.

transforms.name: -아/어요
transforms.description: Informal polite ending (해요체): statement, question, request or suggestion.

transforms.name: past perfect
transforms.description: Past perfect -았었/었었-: had done, used to.

transforms.name: -았/었자
transforms.description: Connective -았/었자: even if, however much (가 봤자).

transforms.name: -(이)야
transforms.description: Plain form of 이다 and 아니다 (해체).

transforms.name: -(으)ㄹ래(요)
transforms.description: Intention or offer: I want to, do you want to.

transforms.name: -자
transforms.description: Plain suggestion: let us (해라체); also "as soon as".

transforms.name: -지(요)
transforms.description: Ending -지: of course, isn’t it; also before 않다 and 못하다.

transforms.name: -거라/-너라
transforms.description: Plain command of 가다 and 오다 (old-fashioned).

transforms.name: -잖아(요)
transforms.description: Ending -잖아(요): you know, as you know.

transforms.name: -고
transforms.description: Connective -고: and; also before 있다, 싶다.

transforms.name: -(으)려 하다
transforms.description: Intend to: -(으)려 하다, -(으)려고 하다 without 고 (written style).

transforms.name: -이에요/예요
transforms.description: Polite form of 이다 and 아니다 (해요체).

transforms.name: -(이)라
transforms.description: Connective of 이다 and 아니다: is (not) ... but; -(이)라면: if it is.

transforms.name: topic -ㄴ
transforms.description: Topic particle 는 contracted with a pronoun: 난 = 나는.

transforms.name: object -ㄹ
transforms.description: Object particle 를 contracted with a pronoun: 날 = 나를.

transforms.name: subject 가
transforms.description: Subject particle 가 with a pronoun: 내가 = 나 + 가, 이게 = 이것이.

transforms.name: possessive
transforms.description: Possessive of a pronoun: 내 = 나의, 제 = 저의.

transforms.name: particle
transforms.description: A personal pronoun with a particle written onto it: 나는 = 나 + 는, 그의 = 그 + 의.
